info.title: osu! coach API
info.description:
The HTTP API of **osu! coach**: it analyses your own osu!standard replays and tells you what to work on.
It runs on your computer and answers only to it (`localhost`).

### How the pieces fit
1. **Find replays** — `POST /api/library/scan` (osu! installs, folders, uploaded files) runs as a background
   job; poll `GET /api/jobs/{id}`.
2. **Choose and analyse** — `GET /api/library/selection` shows which replays an analysis would read;
   `POST /api/analysis` analyses them (a job). Every analysis is also saved in the progress history.
3. **Read the results** — the `/api/profile/*` pages (Overview, Aim, Tapping, Sliders & Reading, Tips & Setup)
   require analysis. Automatic map suggestions use analysed replays; skill playlists can also use manually supplied
   comfort stars and skill ratings.

Remembered choices (`/api/settings`, `/api/setup`) are shared with the `osu-coach` command line.

### Conventions
* Rates and shares are fractions (0–1) unless a field says %; `null` means *not enough data*.
* Times are ISO 8601 in UTC.
* Errors are `{"detail": "...", "code": "..."}` with a stable `code`.

jump_along_pct.title: Jump Along Pct
jump_along_pct.description: Median over(+)/undershoot along the jump, % of its length.

fast_ratio.title: Fast Ratio
fast_ratio.description: Misses on fast patterns vs expected (1.0 = as expected).

normal_ratio.title: Normal Ratio
normal_ratio.description: Misses on normal-speed jumps and notes vs expected.

weight.title: Weight
weight.description: How much the play counts (difficulty weighting), 0–1.

player.title: Player
player.description: Player to analyse; '*' = all; null = the one with most replays.

online.title: Online

profile_replays.title: Profile Replays

folders.title: Folders
folders.description: Extra replay folders, one per line.

level_override.title: Level Override
level_override.description: Level (★) set by hand; null = detected.

manual_comfort.title: Manual Comfort
manual_comfort.description: Star rating for playlists without analysed replays.
